title: The Kerala slow trail
alt: Green Kerala landscape with palm-lined waterways
description: Tea-scented mornings, a day on the water, and a little old-world charm. A gentle introduction to Kerala.

itinerary.title: The road to the hills
itinerary.text: Arrive in Kochi and travel to Munnar, with scenic stops along the way.

itinerary.title: A slower shade of green
itinerary.text: Explore tea gardens and viewpoints, with time for an unhurried afternoon.

itinerary.title: Down to the backwaters
itinerary.text: Travel to Alleppey. Discuss a houseboat or waterside stay when planning your trip.

itinerary.title: A little Kochi magic
itinerary.text: Return to Kochi for heritage streets, cafés, and a relaxed waterfront evening.

itinerary.title: Until next time
itinerary.text: Breakfast and your return transfer, arranged around your onward journey.
